methodology.contract_source: Ghidra 12 decompilation of exact pinned target library
methodology.selector_extraction: brace-depth-aware switches plus equality comparisons whose latest assignment is a request byte
methodology.semantic_rule: Only `reviewed_contract` is manually normalized. `selector_leaf_evidence` and `contract_extraction` preserve static evidence and are not promoted to unsupported semantic names.
methodology.unresolved_rule: External handlers and indirect callbacks remain explicitly unresolved.
methodology.operation_normalization: Every registration has a reviewed top-level raw contract and >=1 CLI/docs operation. Every static leaf ID appears exactly once as selector evidence or merged validation-only evidence. Delegated response schemas stop at the named helper boundary.
methodology.selector_normalization: Each operation has selector_offset and selector_hex. auto_prefix is emitted only when every request byte from offset 0 through the selector is fixed; selectors following variable request bytes remain caller-supplied and are validated at selector_offset.
